status: frozen before tip-only training and independent evaluation capture
scope: Offline RGB-D localization of the cutter TCP on the non-anatomical benchmark sheet. Not a slit-front model, structural-length estimate, stop permit, M5a/M5b acceptance, or permission to change any controller. No structural-length H1 data.

data.train_and_validation: Use only actual 640x480 ECM frames from the locked Phase A development partitions (270 train, 30 validation). Retain all completed captures from both DONE and FAILED runs. No look-back, HD, auxiliary, historical or previously inspected external frames. All frames of each episode stay in its partition.
data.independent_evaluation: 64 new truth-controlled dev-namespace indices reserved in the episode lock. Run the unchanged registered sampler, scene, safety limits and collector with tag tip_v1_eval, aux_views=0, hd_twin=false; never use that tag for training or calibration. Do not generate until weights, threshold, loader, scorer, manifest and recipe are sealed by hashes. Score once; a failed or incomplete evaluation stays failed or incomplete, never retried or replaced.
data.label_source: Apply audit_keypoints.py: camera TCP from label_tcp_M translation transformed by cam_R/cam_t, then camera projection. Score on native clean depth for label status, shared across noise variants.
data.label_policy: Positive = fiducial_candidate, a conservative scored virtual TCP proxy, not direct evidence of a physically visible blade point. Negative = depth_blocked or out_of_view. Unknown = uncertain; omit it from all supervised losses, report its count and separately report any output rates on unknowns. Include pre-sheet frames for the tip if labelled; presence of the sheet is not a feature. Never treat marker colour alone as evidence through a known occluder.
data.input: Raw RGB scaled by 1/255, metric camera-axis depth clipped to [0, far], 4x480x640 NCHW. Reject corrupt frames. No pose, marker truth, provenance, label fields, structural masks, target-centred crop, history or tick may enter the model. Camera intrinsics are used only to decode its estimate into XYZ.

baseline.estimator: cut_perception.CutPerception._scissors, ray_marker_fit=True, default marker sizes, offsets, colours and both existing RMS checks, same fixed tool TCP calibration as learned_perception_v1_roi_dev.json. One exposure at a time, no world coordinates, truth, or motion state. Native RGB 0..255 and the exact same clean/noisy input depth as the model before channel normalization.
baseline.reporting: Report baseline on the same exposures and label partitions, including predictions on blocked and unknown frames; do not censor the baseline using scorer labels. On validation report the raw baseline first, before fitting the learned model.

model.encoder: ResNet-18 initialized from scratch, replace stem with Conv2d(4,64,7,stride=2,padding=3,bias=False), keep stem BN/ReLU/pool and layers 1 and 2 only. Map the stride-8 128-channel feature to 4 maps with one learned 1x1 convolution: heatmap logit, dx, dy and depth logit. A separate Linear(128,1) after spatial average pooling gives visibility logit.
model.decode: Pick the row-major argmax cell in the 60x80 heatmap. UV = (8*(col+0.5)-0.5, 8*(row+0.5)-0.5) + 4*tanh([dx,dy]) at that cell. z = far*sigmoid(depth logit at cell); convert to camera XYZ with the registered inverse projection. Fail closed on non-finite values, invalid depth or out-of-frame UV. Accept only calibrated-by-threshold sigmoid(visibility logit) > tau; this is an operating threshold, not a probability calibration claim.
model.loss: On each known frame use unweighted BCEWithLogits for 1=positive or 0=negative. Add losses on positive frames only: cross-entropy on flattened heatmap against nearest grid centre (ties choose smaller row-major index); Smooth L1 on decoded UV at the labelled cell in pixels averaged over the two components; Smooth L1 on decoded z at that cell in millimetres. Smooth L1 beta=1 in both units. Add the visibility mean over known frames to the mean over positives of the sum of the three equally weighted position losses. If a batch has no positives its position loss is zero, without synthesizing a tip target.
model.recipe: Eight fixed epochs, last epoch only. AdamW lr=0.0003, weight decay=0.01, batch 8, no scheduler, no ImageNet weights, no RGB/depth augmentation in training, retain short batch. Seed 20261123 for model initialization and DataLoader generator; deterministic algorithms enabled (CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8, no cuDNN benchmark), bf16 CUDA autocast with FP32 losses. Require finite scores and losses; retain exact software/GPU versions, seeds, checkpoint hashes and frame counts.

evaluation.depth_variants: Clean, plus one IID mean-zero Gaussian noise draw at sigma=0.0005 m, clipped to [0, far]. Derive seed from first 8 bytes of sha256 of UTF-8 learned_tip_v1/noise/<episode_seed_base10>/<tick_base10>, big endian unsigned, using NumPy Generator(PCG64(seed)) in float64 before conversion; same draw for both readers. Never derive label status from noisy depth.
evaluation.operating_point: Use a single tau across both depth variants. On the 30 dev validation trajectories, choose the largest sigmoid confidence emitted on any explicit negative in either variant (strict >; 0 if no emitted scores). Require at least one explicitly blocked validation frame in each variant and at least one valid supported estimate per variant, otherwise report undefined and do not collect independent evaluation. Never choose a new threshold from evaluation data.
evaluation.metrics: Per reader, variant and scenario: positive support, accepted positive fraction, 2D pixel and 3D error median/p95 on accepted positives, fraction of accepted positives with 3D error >2 mm, accepted counts on explicit blocked/out-of-view frames, and output rates on unknowns. Also report shot timing strata (pre-sheet, loaded uncut, cut) and matched inputs. Rate with empty denominator = undefined. Report coverage-error curves exploratory only; the locked operating point is primary. Include 95% percentile intervals for primary rates from 2000 whole-episode resamples, per variant; PCG64 seed 20261125; omit undefined draws and report their number.
evaluation.development_to_evaluation: Each development depth variant must cover >=90% of positive frames, with median 3D error <0.5 mm, >2 mm error fraction <5% and no output on any explicit negative. These are new tip-only go/no-go criteria, not edits to historical M5a gates. Record any failure and stop before collecting independent evaluation.
evaluation.independent_success: Same per-variant criteria as development. Require at least four distinct evaluation episodes with explicitly blocked frames, and at least one positive frame for each registered scenario, otherwise the result is incomplete. Report comparison with the marker baseline; a learned reader that does not improve the baseline has no demonstrated benefit. No control integration regardless of result.
